skills.name: Boundary Stagger
skills.description: Use fixed boundaries and relative offsets to turn a blocked room into a connected sequence of openings.
skills.exampleDescription: Shift rigid groups around fixed boundaries, make room for the next move, and release the path to the gem.

skills.name: Hook Transfer
skills.description: Transport and dock a shaped tool so one member receives a push while another moves an otherwise restricted object.
skills.exampleDescription: Line up the offset tool, transfer a push to the restricted target, and keep working to reach the gem.

skills.name: Constrained Transport
skills.verb: Deliver the tool. Keep a way back.
skills.description: Rearrange helpers and recover temporary parking space to deliver a tool with a reachable, usable pushing position.
skills.exampleDescription: Borrow a crowded aisle, move the tool through it, and recover the space needed for its final use.

skills.name: Skating Cross
skills.verb: A moving cross. A new place to stop.
skills.description: Move a rigid cross across ice to create stopping points, change pushing sides, collect the gem, and return to the doorway.
skills.exampleDescription: Slide the cross into new stopping positions, collect the gem, then return to the starting doorway.

skills.name: Block Coordination
skills.description: Design MazeBench passages with several movable blocks whose shielding roles are prepared, handed off, retained or released to reach an exit. Uses BxB and BxC; for map authoring.
skills.exampleDescription: An agent-authored realization built with this skill.

skills.name: Bridge Convoy
skills.description: Design and analyze MazeBench puzzles that reserve consumable bridge floors, stage a reusable gate-opening block, and re-form a two-module push convoy after a turn. Based on verified official BxE evidence; for map authoring, not model evaluation.
skills.exampleDescription: An agent-authored realization built with this skill.

skills.name: Clear Ground Turning
skills.description: Design MazeBench passages where a single movable block shields reactive gates and nearby clear ground enables repeated changes of pushing side. Based on ExB; for map authoring.
skills.exampleDescription: An agent-authored realization built with this skill.

skills.name: Enclosure Navigation
skills.description: Design MazeBench reactive-gate passages using a rigid enclosure, protected pushing directions, and safe release. Extracts CxB and DxB mechanisms for map authoring.
skills.exampleDescription: An agent-authored realization built with this skill.
